{{Quote|I'm the Journeyman Protector here...I'm the law.|[[Fett (Elder Journeyman Protector)|Constable Fett]]|<ref name="OpenSeasons1">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 1|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Journeyman Protectors''' were a respected [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|organization]] of [[Police officer/Legends|lawmen]] that operated on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]. Comprised of numerous [[Constable/Legends|constables]] charged with ensuring the safety of the planet's citizens, the Journeyman Protectors answered to the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Concord Dawn, and represented justice in the parts of the planet each patrolled.

==Description==
The Journeyman Protectors were a group of [[Police officer/Legends|lawmen]] who safeguarded the citizens of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]. Well respected for their service,<ref name="Revelation" /> the Journeyman Protectors' numerous [[Constable/Legends|constables]] each patrolled their local territory, and were considered representatives of the law,<ref name="OpenSeasons1" /> answerable to Concord Dawn's sitting [[Governor/Legends|governor]].<ref name="BFiD">[[Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead 4|''Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead'' 4]]</ref>

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]], the Journeyman Protectors wore suits of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] similar to [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|the style]] worn by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the era.<ref name="BFiD" /> Certain Journeyman Protectors wore unique sigils,<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> while exemplary Protectors donned additional [[Color/Legends|red-brown]] honor sashes around their waists as a mark of special recognition.<ref name="VisualDictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The Protectors were trained to work together in [[Squad/Legends|squads]] in order to breach and clear buildings where criminals were thought to be hiding.<ref name="BFiD" />

==History==
{{Quote|He was a Journeyman Protector here for a time. But he killed a man—which is what he does—and he was exiled from Concord Dawn.|[[Sintas Vel]], speaking about [[Boba Fett]]|<ref name="BFiD" />}}
[[File:JasterMereelsSigil-TESB.svg|thumb|left|180px|[[Jaster Mereel]]'s sigil during his time as a Journeyman Protector]]
During the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> Concord Dawn [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Jaster Mereel]] chose to become a Journeyman Protector. A [[Gender/Legends|man]] of strong moral character, Mereel was ultimately expelled from the Protectors and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from Concord Dawn after he killed a corrupt superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. Mereel went on to join the Mandalorians,<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> and his post as a Journeyman Protector was taken up by a [[Farm/Legends|farmer]] named [[Fett (Elder Journeyman Protector)|Fett]]. Fett's own service came to an end when the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|civil war]] between the [[True Mandalorians]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] came to Concord Dawn, claiming his life and that of his [[Jango Fett's mother|wife]],<ref name="OpenSeasons1" /> while his [[Arla Fett|eldest child]] was kidnapped by Death Watch<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and his now orphaned son, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango]], was taken in and raised by Jaster Mereel as a Mandalorian.<ref name="OpenSeasons1" /> After Mereel died, Jango Fett displayed [[Jaster Mereel's sigil|Mereel's Journeyman Protector sigil]] as a means to honor him, recording it in the [[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad|manifesto]] he passed on to his son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]],<ref name="TBHC" /> and exhibiting the symbol on his [[Jaster's Legacy|personal starship]].<ref name="TNEGtVaV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Prior to joining the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]''—a group of veteran [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] chosen to train the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of the nascent [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]]—[[Cort Davin]] served a period of time as a Journeyman Protector. While training [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Davin was responsible for introducing the ways of the Journeyman Protectors to a number of the troopers in his charge. From Davin, [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]] learned the traditions, history, and [[Concordian/Legends|language]] of the Protectors; Bacara came to associate heavily with the Protectors of Concord Dawn, and like them, viewed himself as a man of law and order. The [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] [[Fox (501st Legion)/Legends|Fox]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] also developed a fascination with the Journeyman Protectors during the course of his service to the Republic. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged on, Fox looked forward to a day when the fighting would end, aspiring to join the Protectors' ranks following the conclusion of the war.<ref name="GttGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

After [[Marriage/Legends|marrying]] [[Sintas Vel]], Boba Fett gave up his life as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and settled down with his new family on Concord Dawn,<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> the homeworld of both his biological and adopted grandfathers.<ref name="OpenSeasons1" /> Assuming the name of his adopted grandfather, Jaster Mereel,<ref name="HotM" /> Fett chose to follow in his footsteps and joined the Journeyman Protectors.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> During his service, Fett befriended a fellow Journeyman Protector by the name of [[Lenovar]],<ref name="Revelation" /> who grew to be a mentor to Fett.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> However, Lenovar later raped Sintas Vel, and Fett [[Blaster/Legends|shot]] and killed Lenovar in retribution.<ref name="Revelation" /> Like his grandfather before him,<ref name="HotM" /> history saw Fett expelled from the Protectors and exiled from Concord Dawn for his crimes against a superior officer.<ref name="Revelation" /> Some time later, Lenovar's [[Parent/Legends|father]], Concord Dawn's Governor [[Purton]], sought vengeance against Fett and his family for the death of his son. After attempting to kill Fett on [[Sathiemon]], Purton orchestrated a strike on a Concord Dawn [[Sintas Vel's safe house|residence]] owned by Sintas Vel by a team of Journeyman Protectors. Led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaplan (Journeyman Protector)|Kaplan]], the Protectors were killed during the course of the assault, while Purton himself was slain by Vel's ally [[Connor Freeman]] after the governor attacked her in disbelief,<ref name="BFiD" /> refusing to accept that his son had been her rapist.<ref name="Revelation" />
